description: Unsubscribes and spam complaints of ONE campaign (nev-api). view=summary (default): number of unsubscribes, unsubscribe rate, spam complaints and complaint rate. view=reasons: the reasons people gave when unsubscribing, grouped into canonical buckets. view=segment_breakdown: unsubscribes and complaints per segment; empty when the campaign targeted a single segment or has no segment attribution. Use it to explain a spike in nevent_get_campaign_metrics.unsubscribes or to compare how audiences reacted. Complaint rates above roughly 0.1% put sender reputation at risk: pair a high value with nevent_get_campaign_deliverability. Email campaigns only. For tenant-wide totals use nevent_get_suppressions_summary. Requires ADMIN, OWNER or SUPERADMIN.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID. Get it from nevent_list_campaigns.

view.description: summary (default): unsubscribes, unsubscribe rate, spam complaints and complaint rate. reasons: voluntary unsubscribe reasons grouped into canonical buckets. segment_breakdown: unsubscribes and complaints per segment (empty when the campaign has a single segment or no attribution).

name: nevent_get_campaign_unsubscribes
